title: The Upcoming ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ World Tour Inspired These New Special Mini Edition Trading Cards
summary: The trading cards include five rarity tiers for fans seeking different artwork styles, character moments and interactive features.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The KPop Demon Hunters world concert tour will be big, but the accompanying trading cards are tiny.

KAYOU’s new Kpop Demon Hunters special mini edition trading cards bring the franchise’s collectible card experience to a smaller format, packing 41 collectibles into roughly half the size of KAYOU’s standard cards. The Netflix-official-licensed set spans five rarity tiers and features HUNTR/X, the Saja Boys, and memorable characters and moments, with premium finishes designed to keep the smaller cards visually striking. Built around the franchise’s world concert tour, the collection also introduces lenticular motion cards, show-inspired designs and fan-interaction artwork.

KAYOU describes the release as its first mini-format collectible card set, although it’s not the first Kpop Demon Hunters trading card collection to use the world-tour theme, as an earlier Energy Edition also draws on the concept. With retailers already listing the mini edition as a high-demand product, the release is generating strong interest and may see limited availability.

Each purchase includes 12 mini cards (four packs per box and three mini cards per pack).

Walmart is carrying the mini trading cards from a partner brand with a 4.6-star rating, helping explain the higher price. GameStop lists the four-pack box at $11.99 for shoppers and $11.39 for Pro members, who pay for an annual subscription. Customers can choose in-store pickup, same-day delivery or shipping to their home, with shipped orders arriving within three business days. Best Buy also carries the release, but its listing requires buyers to collect it from a nearby store instead of delivery. Each box contains four packs with three cards per pack from a possible 41 cards across five rarity tiers.

Best Buy

Collectors have a chance to collect across all five rarity tiers, from character profiles to stage-focused artwork. Super Spark Rare cards spotlight characters in specific situations, while Holo Rare cards use lenticular effects to make poses shift as the viewing angle changes. These cards also include a pre-punched hole so fans can turn them into charms. Legacy Rare cards take cues from anime-inspired illustrations and fan photo-card culture, while Special cards focus on HUNTR/X’s relationship with fans, featuring character names, lively expressions and band logos. Creative Rare cards spotlight performances, emphasizing the characters’ stage presence and the excitement of their shows.

The trading cards are just the latest addition to the ever-expanding merch machine surrounding KPop Demon Hunters . Since the film’s breakout success, its characters and iconography have inspired an increasingly eclectic range of products, from shoes and backpacks to Squishmallows and Mattel dolls , and even heavy-duty plastic swords modeled after Rumi’s iconic weapon . Not to mention the KPop Demon Hunters world tour concert lightsticks for the upcoming tour, which was announced in May and slated for 2027. What began as a hit animated movie has quickly become a full-fledged consumer brand, with the new trading card collection offering yet another way for fans to bring a piece of the KPop Demon Hunters universe home.
